rows.note: Use this when something falls apart or disintegrates on its own, especially from being stale, dry, or fragile.

example.english: The bread has been left for days and is so dry that it has started to crumble.
example.traditional: 塊麵包擺咗幾日，乾到散晒喇。
example.jyutping: faai3 min6 baau1 baai2 zo2 gei2 jat6 gon1 dou3 saan2 saai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately breaks something into small crumbs or pieces.

example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoeng1 faai3 beng2 zing2 seoi3 aa3
